rows.name: Anton Weiss
rows.mandate: Gold and silver first, and the reasons people reach for them. Patience over activity.

rows.name: Priya Raghunathan
rows.mandate: Buy what is cheap against its own history and wait. Price paid is the only edge you control.

rows.name: Tobias Lindgren
rows.mandate: Own what is already working. Add to strength, cut what has stopped moving.

rows.name: Beatriz Salgado
rows.mandate: Lose as little as possible. Cash is a position and drawdown is the number that matters.

rows.name: Marisol Vega
rows.mandate: Trade the dollar against the world. Currencies first; everything else is a relative price.

rows.name: Ines Kovac
rows.mandate: Take the other side of whatever this desk agrees on. Consensus is the signal.

rows.name: Grace Okonkwo
rows.mandate: Broad funds, few decisions, low turnover. Beat the others by not trading.

rows.name: Buy and hold
rows.mandate: Every instrument on the list the day the desk opened, equal weight, bought on the first day and never traded again.

rows.name: Emeka Nwosu
rows.mandate: Start from the world — rates, oil, the dollar — and let the holdings follow from it.
